item.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the same way as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)`, `n = (at - start) // length`, then `start + n * length`. Reuse this pattern instead of looping or using date arithmetic.
